#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -Eeuo pipefail
umask 077
export GENOS_PATCH_DEV="${GENOS_DEV_ROOT:-${GENOS_DEV:-$HOME/DEV}}"
task_logs="$PWD/readable-trace-r1-logs"
mkdir -p -- "$task_logs"
task_log="$task_logs/$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)-$$.log"
exec > >(tee -a "$task_log") 2>&1
trap 'task_exit=$?; printf "READABLE_TRACE_EXIT=%s LOG=%s\n" "$task_exit" "$task_log"; printf "%s\n" "$task_exit" > "$task_log.exit"' EXIT
printf 'READABLE_TRACE_LOG=%s\n' "$task_log"
if [[ -n "${GENOS_PYTHON_DIR:-}" ]]; then export PATH="$GENOS_PYTHON_DIR:$PATH"; elif [[ -x /venv/bin/python3 ]]; then export PATH="/venv/bin:$PATH"; fi
if [[ $# -eq 0 ]]; then set -- check; fi
python3 - "$@" <<'READABLE_TRACE_PY'
import base64,hashlib,json,os,sys,types,zlib
raw=zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(''))
assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()=='781f2b14af4c131d0bda07c167e089eaad7d75da2dbbd0b76d6328af789596f8'
bundle=json.loads(raw);module=types.ModuleType('readable_trace_installer')
exec(compile(base64.b64decode(bundle['code']),'apply_patch.py','exec'),module.__dict__)
try:
    raise SystemExit(module.main(bundle['spec'],['--root',os.environ['GENOS_PATCH_DEV'],*sys.argv[1:]]))
except Exception as exc:
    print('READABLE_TRACE FAILED: '+str(exc),file=sys.stderr,flush=True)
    raise SystemExit(1)
READABLE_TRACE_PY
